p5_b0.ocr: As the theme park industry continues to rebound, the latest attendance data for the fourth quarter of FY2025 provides critical insights into performance across various regions. p5_b1.ocr: This uptick in visitor numbers has also contributed to increased revenue, with the North Region reporting a substantial $100M in revenue, while the South Region generated $70M in revenue, indicating robust market dynamics. Financial performance metrics further illustrate this trend, as the South Region achieved a net income of $14M, and the West Region realized a net income of $16M, reflecting effective operational efficiency and strategic investments.
